attachments.displayName: One of the sensors from my Closet Door Lightswitch project (http://tinkeringetc.blogspot.com/2013/03/closet-door-lightswitch.html) stopped working the other week. Last time I was home I checked it out and determined the reed switch wasn't working anymore. This is the second time I've had to replace it (the first time was because it got crushed - glass tubes do not hold up to a slamming door very well). If I knew how much trouble they would be, I would've used a hall effect sensor instead. I also wish I would've designed a PCB so I would have replacements if one breaks. Now I have to take the whole sensor to my apartment to fix it and leave my parents with a non-working closet.
